entry.name: dict.print
entry.digest: Post a dictionary to the Max Console
entry.description: Use the dict.print object to post the content of a dictionary to the Max Console. For more control over how the printing is formatted, use dict.iter and print.

arguments.description: The argument is an identifier for theobject. Each message printed in the Max Console is preceded by the name of theobject. If there is no argument, the name is.
